card.name: Ending of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2, -6 or -15. It also fires weakly on a few other partway-through-word pieces.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The closing "in" of interleukin, right before the number naming the specific interleukin.

modes.label: Other word interiors
modes.description: Odd partway-through-word pieces in rare words or Lao script, such as anecdotally or phenotyped.
